items.title: Plastics contamination an ‘overlooked’ concern in food waste schemes, experts say
items.description: <p>Researchers find microplastics can persist in compost, leaching into agricultural soils</p><p>Plastic contamination should be a central concern in efforts to deal with food waste, which campaigners call one of the most overlooked problems of the climate crisis, researchers have said.</p><p>This is despite the fact that, as the chef, author and activist Max La Manna puts it, food waste management is “one of the few climate problems where everyone wins”.</p>

items.title: Kosovo PM Kurti egged in parliament amid political crisis
items.description: Kosovo has held three elections in over two years. Albin Kurti's ruling Vetevendosje is struggling to garner the two-thirds majority required to elect a president.

items.title: EU holds talks with big tech over Ceuta misinformation
items.description: EU digital chief Henna Virkkunen has called for closer monitoring of social media platforms moving forward, amid the spread of misinformation during the recent migrant influx at Spain's Ceuta.

items.title: Trump's ex-lawyer Todd Blanche narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
items.description: The vote cements Trump's former criminal defence lawyer as the nation's top law enforcement official despite a rare pushback from some Republicans.

items.title: US Senate confirms Trump loyalist Todd Blanche as new AG
items.description: Republicans dropped their opposition and confirmed President Donald Trump's former defense lawyer to a Cabinet position. Now, Todd Blanche will act as the nation's top law enforcement officer.
